name: wt-pack
description: wt-pack: every wt-* skill for running herdr agents on a ticket pipeline, plus wt-memory's hooks (preferences, pkill guard) and MCP server, and the wt MCP server (typed ticket, handoff, room and ask tools). The dashboard, board and rooms need the full ./setup.
